topography.project_purpose: Asymmetry Finance provides liquid staking derivative (LSD) index products and a collateralized debt position (CDP) stablecoin system. It aggregates multiple LSD tokens into diversified baskets and enables users to mint a stablecoin against these assets.
topography.relationship_narrative: The Asymmetry Finance family issues LSD index tokens (like afETH) that serve as collateral within the Asymmetry USDaf CDP system. Collateral registries in USDaf reference these index tokens, creating a direct dependency where the index products provide the asset base for stablecoin minting.
